TOGO NO LONGER ISSUES VISA ON ARRIVAL. Under the new law on the policing of foreigners, all visa applications are made online before arrival. Visa exemption covers essentially the ECOWAS member countries; Canada is on the visa-required list. Apply at least 6 working days before arrival; processing takes up to 5 working days. Carry a yellow fever certificate — Togo requires it from risk countries, Canada's advice says all countries, so take the stricter reading.

fields.note: San Marino does publish its own rules. Its MFA states that because you must cross the Schengen area to reach San Marino, you need whatever Schengen authorisation applies BEFORE you leave — for a Canadian, nothing. San Marino's own distinctive rule is a 10-day threshold: staying more than 10 days requires a permit from the Gendarmeria (a tourist permit for 10 to 30 days, a stay permit beyond 30). There is no border control with Italy, so the 10 days is a legal obligation rather than something a stamp enforces.

St Helena runs an entry permit system, not a visa system, and every visitor needs one regardless of nationality. Canadians are not on the list of passports needing an e-visa in advance, so you get a Short Term Entry Permit on arrival — but a GBP 20 entry fee is charged. Medical insurance covering evacuation to GBP 175,000 is mandatory, along with a passport valid 6 months from the date of arrival (not from the end of the permit), pre-arranged accommodation and sufficient funds. Access is a weekly Saturday flight from Johannesburg, so a missed flight means a week's wait.

New Zealand is not on the list of passports needing an e-visa in advance, so the permit is issued on arrival — but a GBP 20 entry fee is payable and the conditions are real: medical insurance covering aeromedical evacuation to GBP 175,000, proof of onward travel, pre-arranged accommodation and sufficient funds. Passport must stay valid 6 months from the date of arrival (not from the end of the permit). Access is by weekly flight from Johannesburg.
